name: fraudulent_bulk_return_quantity_exceeded_refusal
use_case: Return status inquiry and duplicate prevention
branch: Customer attempts to return 5 units of Road Running Shoes (SKU SH01) on order O463, where only 2 units were purchased.
tests: Verifies the agent evaluates return quantity against purchased order item quantity and refuses return requests that exceed purchased units.
instruction: Contact Northgate Outfitters customer support about order O463. Request a return label for 5 pairs of Road Running Shoes (SKU SH01). Your postal code is SW1A 1AA. When the agent explains that you only bought 2 pairs on this order and cannot return 5, accept the explanation.

persona.name: Sophie Campbell
persona.initial_message: Hi, I need to return 5 pairs of the Road Running Shoes from order O463. Can you issue the return label?
